> **Length**(`min`, `max?`, `validationOptions?`): `PropertyDecorator`

Defined in: node\_modules/.pnpm/class-validator@0.14.4/node\_modules/class-validator/types/decorator/string/Length.d.ts:12

Checks if the string's length falls in a range. Note: this function takes into account surrogate pairs.
If given value is not a string, then it returns false.
